findings.title: Bind the actual prepared wire before dispatch
findings.finding: request_evidence returns the same mutable dictionary containing Prepared.wire. complete validates only the original high-level request hash. Mutating wire max_tokens or provider routing after upper_quote sends the altered request without a new reservation or a wire-integrity check.
findings.impact: The dispatched request can exceed the reserved output ceiling or re-enable fallback while the stored wire_request_sha256 still describes the old request.
findings.fix_direction: Return an independent evidence snapshot; retain immutable serialized wire bytes or recompute/verify a separately stored wire digest immediately before dispatch. Ensure mutations cannot alter prepared input through aliases.
findings.scope_limit: This reproduction mutates the public in-process evidence object; no remote model path to that object was demonstrated.

findings.title: Block the next run while a prior campaign admission is unfinished
findings.finding: An admission remains reserved if the process dies after dispatch or before finish. On reopening, blocked is still false, and admit chooses the next not-yet-admitted id without requiring earlier admissions to be settled. The next run is admitted despite unknown prior charge status.
findings.impact: A crash bypasses the documented stop-on-uncertain-charge policy and permits additional dispatch. Holding the previous full run cap still bounds planned reservations under the stated honest-provider premise; this finding does not claim that cap arithmetic alone was exceeded.
findings.fix_direction: Serialize campaign admission against all unfinished/reserved/uncertain earlier runs, with explicit reviewed reconciliation before continuation.

findings.title: Durably retain known charges before fallible response processing
findings.finding: A valid reported charge is discarded if later usage-field validation throws before Reply is returned. Separately, the runner persists the response artifact before settlement, so an artifact write failure downgrades an already-known bill to a quoted uncertain hold.
findings.impact: Both probes received a 110000-microusd cost but recorded spent=0 and only a 4800-microusd run hold; campaign accounting held 100000 and recorded no known spend. The artifact-failure receipt itself still records actual_microusd=110000, contradicting its budget summary.
findings.fix_direction: Keep valid billing information when other reply fields are invalid; settle or retain known liability durably before artifact writes or answer/token validation can fail. Preserve uncertainty for any additional unknown charge without replacing known spend.

probes.scenario: Mutate exposed wire after quote while original request stays unchanged
Reopen campaign with unfinished first run then admit next run
Provider reports valid cost 110000 microusd but invalid usage token
Valid known overrun followed by response artifact write failure
Positive control: intact known overrun remains billed and blocked
Positive control: caught transport uncertainty blocks and retains hold

positive_observations: Fixed HTTPS destination, disabled proxy routing and redirect refusal prevent the reviewed transport from intentionally forwarding its credential elsewhere.
No SDK retry loop, tools or streaming path is present. Prepared calls are consumed before transport and call/run identities cannot repeat within their existing ledgers.
Ordinary caught timeouts retain liability and block; intact known overrun settlement records the full charge and blocks.
Quotation uses the entire advertised input context as requested; this was not treated as an estimation defect.
limits: Source and synthetic fixture review only; no actual seed, private storage, credentials, metadata network or paid calls.
Provider enforcement of advertised limits, routing and tariffs remains an explicit external premise.
The guard is not a defense against arbitrary Python code with authority to bypass the guard entirely.
Real crash durability, SQLite power-loss behavior, provider billing semantics and production credentials were not exercised.
test_live_admission.py was read but not executed; some tests load the actual benchmark seed.
reproduction_method: Inline Python under the repository .venv, temporary directories strictly within dag/benchmark, reference_runner.HERE rebound to harmless synthetic seed and commitment, inert fake transport only; actual HTTPTransport.request replaced with an assertion failure. No implementation source edits.
